name: Folio Database
purpose: Top-level container for all five Folio collections
notes: Console > Databases > Add database. Put its ID in FOLIO_CONFIG.databaseId

name: Profiles
purpose: One row per user. Document $id equals the Appwrite Account ID
notes: Each document gets: read user:<userId> + read team:admins. Rows are created ONLY by backend/create_user.py

name: Subjects
purpose: Academic subject groupings shown in the sidebar and library filters
notes: archived=true hides a subject without deleting it

name: Documents
purpose: One row per library resource - metadata only, never file contents
notes: searchText is the lowercase search blob: title + description + subject + file name + tags

name: Document Versions
purpose: One row per uploaded file revision. Highest versionNumber = current version

name: Starred Documents
purpose: Per-user bookmarks. Each row carries owner-only document permissions
notes: Frontend sets read/update/delete user:<userId> on every row, so members see only their own stars

name: Folio Administrators
purpose: Server-enforced admin role - grants write access everywhere

name: Folio Viewers
notes: Role = team membership; the profiles.role field is display only

name: Folio Resources
purpose: Binary file storage for every uploaded document
notes: Max file size per plan (25 MB on Cloud free tier). Allowed extensions: pdf, docx, doc, pptx, ppt, xlsx, xls, txt, csv, png, jpg, jpeg, webp, mp4, zip
